description: DEFAULT DATA (no rule) for the surface-inversion, temporal-conflict and named-trope goal layers, so they auto-fire on an article read WITHOUT a per-analysis teach. Ships ONLY graph DATA: the three MethodSpecs the agent AUTHORS each classify-by-join rule from, plus starter codebooks -- DistancingCue (surface content voiced at a distance / not the speaker's own stance), OpposingActionPair (support-then-undermine composite keys the temporal layer joins), and TropeSignature (the strategic-schema NAMES from the TVTropes vocabulary the named-trope layer joins). The RULES are DELIBERATELY NOT shipped here (each layer's _no_shipped_*_rule test asserts it): the only SurfaceInversionReading / TemporalConflictReading / TropeReading rules are the ones the agent authors at runtime from these method texts via its procedural_reader -> binding_resolver -> method_synthesis faculty (domains/actor_goals.ensure_*_rule). Codebooks are the agent's held, teach()-extensible data -- a new row grows coverage with zero code/rule change.

attrs.name: surface_inversion
attrs.text: When an utterance phrase's phrase matches a distancing cue's phrase, classify a surface inversion reading.

attrs.name: temporal_conflict
attrs.text: When an action pair fact's pair_key matches an opposing action pair's pair_key, classify a temporal conflict reading.

attrs.name: named_trope
attrs.text: When a temporal conflict reading's pair_key matches a trope signature's pair_key, classify a trope reading.
